summary: Tested new Master Board tabs (Tasks, Trackboard, Pages, Team, Ad.Tasks, Meeting) and sorting functionality. Fixed critical bug in Ad.Tasks and Meeting modals where SelectItem had empty string value causing React error. All 14 backend API tests passed. All 6 tabs are visible and functional.
updated_files: /app/frontend/src/pages/DLOperationsPage.js - Fixed SelectItem empty value bug in Ad.Tasks and Meeting modals
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST_ prefixed tasks and meetings
context_for_next_testing_agent: Master Board has 6 tabs: Tasks, Trackboard, Pages, Team, Ad.Tasks, Meeting. Sorting toggle (Oldest First/Newest First) works on Tasks, Ad.Tasks, and Meetings tabs. Ad.Tasks modal allows creating tasks with title, description, due date, priority, assignee, and project link. Meeting modal allows scheduling with title, agenda, date, time, type (Video/Audio/In-person), meeting link, and project link.

details: Tasks tab - shows task list with stage filters
Trackboard tab - shows Time Tracking Overview (Total Time Today, Active Timers, Tasks Completed)
Pages tab - shows page list from all projects with view icons
Team tab - shows team members with task counts (Tasks, Active)
Ad.Tasks tab - shows additional tasks with Start timer, Complete, Delete buttons
Meeting tab - shows meetings with date, time, status, Complete, Delete buttons
GET /api/additional-tasks/ - List all tasks
POST /api/additional-tasks/ - Create new task
PUT /api/additional-tasks/{id}/status - Update status (To-Do, In Progress, Completed, Paused)
PUT /api/additional-tasks/{id}/add-time - Add time spent
DELETE /api/additional-tasks/{id} - Delete task
GET /api/meetings/ - List all meetings
GET /api/meetings/upcoming - Get upcoming meetings
GET /api/meetings/my-meetings - Get user's meetings
POST /api/meetings/ - Create new meeting
PUT /api/meetings/{id}/status - Update status (scheduled, ongoing, completed, cancelled)
DELETE /api/meetings/{id} - Delete meeting
GET /api/meetings/calendar/status - Check Google Calendar connection
Toggle button visible on Tasks, Ad.Tasks, and Meetings tabs
Toggles between 'Oldest First' and 'Newest First'
Sorting applied to list items
Modal opens without errors after fix
Fields: Title, Description, Due Date, Priority (Low/Medium/High/Urgent), Assignee, Project
Create Task button submits form
Task appears in list after creation
Modal opens without errors after fix
Fields: Title, Agenda/Description, Date, Meeting Type (Video/Audio/In-person), Start Time, End Time, Meeting Link, Project
Schedule Meeting button submits form

bug_fixed.issue: SelectItem with empty string value causing React error in Ad.Tasks and Meeting modals
bug_fixed.error_message: A <Select.Item /> must have a value prop that is not an empty string
bug_fixed.root_cause: SelectItem value='' for 'No Project' and 'Unassigned' options
bug_fixed.fix: Changed empty string values to 'none' and handle conversion in onValueChange
